notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Fixed some mission bugs. Added mission tips.

notes.title: Added settings to invert the Y and X axes of the camera when playing with a co
notes.notes:
If you cannot set it or the game crashes, delete the following directory files
C:\Users\(Name)\AppData\LocalLow\RouShanGame\GunParadise\GameDataInfo.json

notes.title: Battlefield mission modification, skill mod modification
notes.notes:
All missions are modified to be opened randomly.
Removed the space station battlefield.
Skill mods are added to the battle by default and no longer need to be developed.
Skill mods no longer increase energy consumption.

Added battlefield enemy reinforcement information display to the mission interface.
Added 1 battlefield to the infinite battlefield.

notes.title: Close Steam download shader cache and start the game
notes.notes: [p]Unable to start, slow startup when launching the game. Turn off Steam shader cache and it will launch normally.[/p][p]Settings>Downloads>Enable Shader Pre-cachingCache (off)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537700/e131003695511efb43d897a1b9d7f5dd12a44615.jpg"][/img][/p]
